title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 12: various gifts and one Spirit, one body with many members, the foot and the ear, and those God set in the assembly.

questions.text: According to verse 3, what can no one say except by the Holy Spirit?
questions.explanation: The verse says no one can say, "Jesus is Lord," but by the Holy Spirit.

questions.text: What do verses 4 to 6 say about the various kinds of gifts, service and workings?
questions.explanation: The verses say there are various kinds of gifts but the same Spirit, various kinds of service and the same Lord, various kinds of workings but the same God.

answers.text: There are various kinds, but the same Spirit, Lord and God
There is one kind of each for every believer
Each kind comes from a different spirit
The kinds will all cease in time

questions.text: Which two gifts does verse 8 name?
questions.explanation: The verse says that to one is given the word of wisdom through the Spirit, and to another the word of knowledge.

answers.text: Faith and the gifts of healings
Prophecy and the discerning of spirits
The word of wisdom and the word of knowledge
Different kinds of languages and their interpretation

questions.text: How does verse 11 say the Spirit distributes these gifts?
questions.explanation: The verse says the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

answers.text: Equally to all of them at the same time
Only to those who ask him for them
According to each one's own labor
To each one separately, as he desires

questions.text: According to verse 13, into what were they all baptized in one Spirit?
questions.explanation: The verse says that in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, bond or free.

questions.text: What does the foot say in verse 15?
questions.explanation: The verse quotes the foot saying, "Because I'm not the hand, I'm not part of the body," and answers that it is still part of the body.

answers.text: "Because I'm not the hand, I'm not part of the body"
"Because I'm not the eye, I'm not part of the body"
"I have no need for you, I am the whole body"
"If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be?"

questions.text: Who set the members in the body, according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: The verse says God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

questions.text: What does verse 26 say happens when one member is honored?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

answers.text: The member is set over the rest
All the members rejoice with it

questions.text: Whom did God set first in the assembly, according to verse 28?
questions.explanation: The verse lists first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers and others.

questions.text: What does verse 31 tell them to desire earnestly?
questions.explanation: The verse says to earnestly desire the best gifts, and adds that he shows a most excellent way to them.
